name: Bayou Bara Game
source:
A hunt. A cryptid. A bara husband. 

A short game prototype for a longer project. Contains binaural elements, playing with headphones recommended. 

[From [url=https://zeus-japonicus.itch.io/bayou-bara-game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场狩猎。一个神秘生物。一位壮汉老公。

这是一款为更长篇作品制作的短篇原型游戏，含双耳音效，建议佩戴耳机游玩。

[摘自[url=https://zeus-japonicus.itch.io/bayou-bara-game]itch.io[/url]]
